Cloverdale acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more, from the MLS®. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Cloverdale market context, June to September 2026

Cloverdale had 201 houses and 194 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 32 and 37 sold in the month. Acreages are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

faq.q: Is Cloverdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Cloverdale had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Cloverdale that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Cloverdale homes?
faq.a: The Cloverdale homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Cloverdale market stats page has the monthly figures.
